title: Monsoon transition: Public advised to be wary of weather changes | The Star
text:
Monsoon transition: Public advised to be wary of weather changes | The Star
KUALA LUMPUR: The public is urged to remain vigilant regarding weather forecasts and alerts issued by the Malaysian Meteorological Department (MetMalaysia) due to the transitional phase of the monsoon from March to May.
Civil Defence Force (APM) chief commissioner Datuk Aminurrahim Mohamed said people should be more cautious as weather changes such as heavy rain and storms could lead to flash floods and landslides.
